verdict.rationale: SOSPortal lets users retrieve their own filings from the My Submissions page, and copies of filed documents and certificates can be ordered online for per-document fees. That gives piecemeal access to a user's records, but nothing is documented about bulk export, the formats used, or a self-serve full-account export. missing for 10: bulk or full-account data export, documented open/machine-readable export formats, free self-serve retrieval of all records, independent or hands-on corroboration.
